name: BOLA / Multi-Tenant Query Isolation Guardrail
prompt: Implement user ownership scoping on the Item model and ensure that ItemUpdateView and ItemDeleteView strictly override get_queryset() to filter by request.user. Verify that attempting to access another user's item raises a 404 Http404 rather than leaking data.

verification.criteria: Cross-user object mutations return 404 response codes and reject unauthenticated modification
